worlds.title: Harvest Corn Maze
worlds.subtitle: Find your way, help a friend

missions.title: Pumpkin Patch Path
missions.intro: The animals are getting ready for the Harvest Festival. Help our explorer choose the right pumpkin for the celebration.
missions.question: Which pumpkin is the biggest?
missions.sub: Look closely at the pumpkins in the picture.
missions.hint: Compare the pumpkins by how much space each one takes up.
missions.tip: Look carefully. The biggest thing is not always closest to you.

missions.title: Dino Hollow
missions.intro: Three eggs rolled away from the nest. Match the clue and help return the right egg.
missions.question: Which egg matches the blue-spotted clue?
missions.sub: Look for the egg with blue spots.
missions.hint: Only one egg has blue spots.
missions.tip: Match one detail at a time.

missions.title: Blocky Barn
missions.intro: The builder is finishing a little bridge before sunset. Use early math to decide how many blocks are still needed.
missions.question: A builder has 5 blocks and needs 8. How many more are needed?
missions.hint: 5... 6, 7, 8. How many numbers did you add?
missions.tip: You can count aloud or use your fingers.

missions.title: Harvest Corn Maze
missions.intro: Follow the clues, solve Halloween puzzles, and reach the scarecrow in the center of the maze.
missions.question: Which path leads to the scarecrow?
missions.sub: Look at the clues around the maze.
missions.tip: Look for clues near the turns.

missions.title: Moonlit Rescue Bay
missions.intro: Two friends reached the same pumpkin bucket at the same time. Help them solve the problem kindly.
missions.question: What is a fair idea?
missions.sub: Choose the answer that helps both friends.
missions.hint: A fair answer gives both friends a chance.
missions.tip: Think about what would feel fair to both friends.
